pinterest_patterns: Knitwear is the hero piece: chunky or textured crewnecks, half-zips, zip cardigans, striped jumpers and knit polos in grey, navy, cream and brown, usually boxy or ending at the waist.
Proportion is always short or boxy on top and long and wide below: baggy straight jeans and pleated wide chinos that pool over the shoe. No slim fits apart from a few outlier pins.
Denim leads the bottoms: light and mid-wash baggy jeans dominate, with stone or beige chinos and black wide trousers as the alternates.
The palette is neutral (ecru/cream, grey, navy, brown, stone) with light-blue denim, and usually one colour pop at the feet (burgundy, red or navy Samba/Spezial).
Shoes are low-profile terrace sneakers (Samba/Spezial/Gazelle in navy, brown, burgundy) plus suede clogs or loafers; white sneakers appear only on outlier pins.
Layering is easy and visible: a white tee showing at the hem and neck under knits, a cream knit under a brown suede or leather bomber, a short-sleeve shirt over a tank or long-sleeve tee in summer.
Accessories carry the 'quietly expensive' finish: dark baseball caps, steel or leather watches, chunky Acne-style scarves, totes and crossbody bags, and flat-lays with fragrance and a watch.

A handful of slim-chino-and-white-sneaker and double-breasted tailoring pins show a pull toward smarter dressing that hasn't yet been translated into his relaxed-fit language. That gap is the main opportunity.

looks.source: Studio Nicholson: Men's Spring 26 Looks (brand lookbook)
looks.formula: Short dark bomber + long high-rise camel pleated trouser + black loafer
looks.why: The trouser does the work: a high-rise, deep-pleated camel wide leg makes a plain short jacket look tailored and expensive. Reads as polished without a blazer, so it says 'boss, not banker'.
looks.fit_for_him: Keep the jacket cropped at the waist (COS/Arket bomber or a leather blouson) and invest in one camel wool-blend wide pleated trouser with full break; swap the plain loafer for a brown Premiata or a horsebit loafer if he wants it less stark.

looks.source: GQ: '36 Ways to Wear a Jacket Right Now, as Seen at Milan Fashion Week' (Milan Men's FW26 street style, Jan 2026; photo Cris Fragkou)
looks.formula: Blue-on-blue top half + tobacco wide trouser + black loafer
looks.why: Tonal blues up top against a warm tobacco trouser is a grown-up colour move, and the tie with denim makes a casual jacket feel intentional. Looks creative and confident rather than corporate.
looks.fit_for_him: Use his existing denim jacket (cropped, not oversized) over a light-blue oxford; the new piece is a tobacco/rust wide chino; tie optional (a knit tie for dates), shoes brown Spezial or loafers.
looks.trend: more trendy, peak (ties with casual pieces)

looks.source: nss magazine: 'The Best Street Style Looks from Pitti Uomo 110 in Florence' (Jun 2026; photo Alberto Castellano)
looks.formula: Brown DB blazer + light-blue shirt + ecru wide trouser + horsebit loafer
looks.why: A split suit (dark jacket, pale trouser) feels relaxed yet properly dressed, and the horsebit loafer is a refined, non-plain shoe that finishes it. Instant 'quietly expensive' for a christening or Sunday lunch.
looks.fit_for_him: Brown or tobacco DB blazer (COS/Arket) with ecru wide trousers and a light-blue shirt; skip the tie or open the collar; this is the place to try his first horsebit loafer.

looks.source: GQ: '58 Ways to Get Dressed Up, Even When It's Boiling Hot Outside' (Paris Men's SS26 street style, Jun 2025; photo Cris Fragkou)
pieces: black-and-ecru striped wide trousers with turn-ups
looks.formula: Plain light top half + statement striped wide trouser + black loafer
looks.why: All the personality is in one great trouser, so the rest can stay plain; it looks fashion-literate without any logos.
looks.fit_for_him: Pair a striped wide trouser (Studio Nicholson/COS) with a white tee and an ecru overshirt or linen jacket; keep shoes black loafers or black Samba; only one statement per outfit.

looks.source: Vogue: 'The Best Street Style Photos From the Spring 2027 Menswear Shows in Milan' (Jun 2026; photo Acielle / Style Du Monde)
looks.formula: Tan suede blouson open over a white tank + cream wide trouser + loafer
looks.why: It takes his favourite tank-and-open-layer move and makes it evening-worthy with suede and a pale wide trouser. Warm, tanned, confident.
looks.fit_for_him: Directly wearable: ribbed tank (A&F/Les Deux), a tan suede or nubuck blouson, cream wide trousers and a brown belt; brown suede loafer or burgundy Spezial instead of black loafers.

looks.source: Vogue: 'The Best Street Style Photos From the Spring 2027 Menswear Shows in Milan' (Jun 2026; photo Acielle / Style Du Monde)
pieces: navy short-sleeve knit polo with ecru tipping
looks.formula: Tipped knit polo + black wide trouser + structured leather bag
looks.why: Swapping the tee for a knit polo is the fastest upgrade in menswear: the collar frames the face and the tipping is a quiet detail. Very Milan, very put-together.
looks.fit_for_him: Navy or brown knit polo (Les Deux/A&F/COS) tucked loosely into black or navy wide trousers; carry a leather tote rather than a backpack; black Spezial or loafers.

looks.source: MR PORTER The Journal: 'Four Ways To Wear Brown' (15 Oct 2025)
looks.formula: Textured brown blouson + ecru tee + greige wide jean + brown leather shoe
looks.why: Tonal brown with texture (cord against soft denim) is the season's easiest rich-looking formula and suits his colouring.
looks.fit_for_him: A cropped corduroy or suede blouson over an ecru tee with stone/greige wide jeans; brown Spezial or Premiata for weekends, brown derbies when dressier.

looks.source: Studio Nicholson: Men's Autumn 26 Looks (brand lookbook)
looks.formula: Suede shirt-jacket + tonal shirt + winter-white wide trouser + suede shoe
looks.why: A suede overshirt with pale trousers in autumn looks deliberate and wealthy, and it is a smarter alternative to the chore jackets he dislikes.
looks.fit_for_him: A suede or suede-look overshirt in tobacco (Arket/COS/Studio Nicholson) over a brown or ecru shirt with ecru wide trousers; suede loafers or brown Spezial.

looks.source: Studio Nicholson: Winter Module 25 Looks (brand lookbook)
pieces: brown-and-ecru waffle-check half-zip knit with contrast trims
looks.formula: Textured statement half-zip + light wide jeans + brown leather shoe
looks.why: It is his favourite Pinterest formula (knit + baggy jeans) pushed up a level by a proper textured knit and leather shoes instead of sneakers.
looks.fit_for_him: Directly wearable: a boxy patterned half-zip (Les Deux/Studio Nicholson/YMC) over a white tee, light-wash wide jeans, and brown leather boat shoes or brown Gazelle.

looks.source: MR PORTER The Journal: 'A Guide To The Best Knitwear For Sweater Weather' (30 Sep 2026)
pieces: navy chunky ribbed zip-up knit cardigan
looks.formula: Heavy zip knit worn as the jacket + shirt collar + black wide trouser + loafer
looks.why: A heavyweight zip knit replaces a blazer and the shirt collar adds just enough polish; dark, simple, and very 'quiet money' for dinner.
looks.fit_for_him: Navy chunky zip knit (COS/Arket) zipped up over a light-blue oxford, black or charcoal wide wool trousers, black loafers or a suede loafer for texture.

looks.source: GQ: '36 Ways to Wear a Jacket Right Now, as Seen at Milan Fashion Week' (Milan Men's FW26 street style, Jan 2026; photo Cris Fragkou)
looks.formula: Buttoned DB jacket + open white collar + black wide trouser + loafer
looks.why: A buttoned double-breasted jacket with no tie is the sharpest night-out silhouette there is, and the open collar keeps it relaxed and young.
looks.fit_for_him: A soft DB jacket in navy (COS) over a white or ecru shirt with the top buttons open and black wide trousers; Rolex for dinners, no necklace needed.

looks.source: Vogue: 'The Best Street Style Photos From the Fall 2026 Menswear Shows in Milan' (Jan 2026; photo Acielle / Style Du Monde)
looks.formula: Statement suede coat over head-to-toe winter whites
looks.why: One great coat over tonal whites is the most elegant winter look in this set; it reads expensive from across the room.
looks.fit_for_him: A long suede or brushed-wool coat in tobacco/camel over an ecru rollneck and cream wide wool trousers; brown suede boots or loafers; keep everything else plain.

looks.source: GQ: 'How to Layer Like a Pro at Fashion Week' (Milan Men's FW26 street style, Jan 2026; photo Cris Fragkou)
looks.formula: Tonal brown layers + a long textured scarf + grey knit as the break
looks.why: Layering shades of brown with a long knitted scarf gives depth without colour; a grey knit underneath stops it going flat.
looks.fit_for_him: Brown wool jacket or overshirt, grey crewneck, brown wide wool trousers and a long scarf (instead of a beanie); black derbies or brown Spezial.

looks.source: Vogue: 'The Best Street Style Photos From the Fall 2026 Menswear Shows in Milan' (Jan 2026; photo Acielle / Style Du Monde)
pieces: navy duffle coat with ecru toggles
looks.formula: Heritage duffle coat + dark wide trouser + sunglasses
looks.why: A navy duffle worn with wide trousers and sunglasses turns a schoolboy classic into something cool and modern.
looks.fit_for_him: Short-to-mid navy duffle over a hoodie or knit, black or dark-denim wide trousers, black Samba or derbies; a modern way into heritage outerwear.

looks.source: Studio Nicholson: Men's Winter 26 Looks (brand lookbook)
pieces: grey textured wool bomber with dark collar
looks.formula: Grey wool bomber + burgundy knit + dark wide jeans + brown suede shoes
looks.why: Grey with a flash of burgundy is a refined colour pairing, and a wool bomber looks far richer than a puffer.
looks.fit_for_him: Grey wool or check bomber (COS/Arket/Studio Nicholson) over a burgundy crewneck, dark rinse wide jeans and brown suede loafers or Spezial; burgundy is one of his best colours.

looks.source: GQ: 'The 41 Biggest Pants and Jackets We Saw at Paris Fashion Week' (Paris Men's FW26 street style, Jan 2026; photo Cris Fragkou)
pieces: distressed brown leather car coat with shearling collar
looks.formula: Vintage-look leather car coat + extra-wide dark jeans + black shoes
looks.why: A worn leather coat with huge jeans is the street look done with adult materials; it is cool without trying.
looks.fit_for_him: Brown leather or suede car coat (vintage, or Arket/COS) over a knit, dark wide jeans and black derbies or black Samba; his most 'Copenhagen street' winter look.
